lines.text: 你有天赋，你有力量。而能力越大，责任越大。
lines.en: You have a gift. You have power. And with great power, there must also come great responsibility.
lines.note: 梅婶临终前对彼得说出的对白；IMDb quotes／片中字幕可核（系列经典句在本片由梅亲口说出）。

lines.text: 如果你能帮别人做点好事，你就有道义责任去做。
lines.en: If you could do good things for other people, you had a moral obligation to do those things.
lines.note: 梅姨对「能力越大责任越大」的朴素版本；IMDb quotes 可查。
